title: Panic
body: The new thing reads as the end of the world. Alarm, doomsaying, energy spent proving it shouldn't be happening.

title: Adoption
body: Everyone gets the tool. Fast, uneven, mostly to do the old work a little faster.

title: The Dip
body: The results disappoint. This is the chapter we are in now, and it has appeared in every revolution.

title: Redesign
body: The work, the roles, and the structures get rebuilt around the new capability. The returns arrive here.

title: Ordinary
body: It disappears into furniture. Nobody remembers being afraid. Nobody wants the payphone back.
